text: The CMA CGM Foundation describes the CMA CGM Group as family-owned. Rodolphe Saadé chairs the group's board of directors, whose 14 directors include members of the Saadé family shareholder and Robert Yüksel Yildirim, CEO of the Turkish group Yildirim.
short: CMA CGM is family-owned; Rodolphe Saadé chairs its board

source.name: CMA CGM Group — The CMA CGM Foundation
source.quote: the CMA CGM Foundation reflects the values of the family-owned CMA CGM Group

additionalSources.name: CMA CGM Group — Governance: leadership and board of directors
additionalSources.quote: Mr Rodolphe Saadé chairs the Board of Directors of CMA CGM. The Board of Directors consists of 14 Directors, including members of the Saadé family shareholder, Mr. Robert Yüksel Yildirim (CEO of the Turkish Group YILDIRIM)
